rules.name: probe: contract checks
rules.replace:
<script>
(function () {
  var P = window.__probe = { events: [], results: {}, started: Date.now() };
  var pass = function (k, ok, note) { P.results[k] = { ok: !!ok, note: note == null ? '' : String(note) }; };
  pass('runsBeforeDom', !document.querySelector('[data-chat="message"]'));
  pass('currentScriptIsElement', !!document.currentScript && document.currentScript.tagName === 'SCRIPT', String(document.currentScript));
  pass('sdkKeys12', Object.keys(sdk).length === 12, Object.keys(sdk).sort().join(','));
  pass('noOffOnce', typeof sdk.off === 'undefined' && typeof sdk.once === 'undefined');
  pass('versionString', sdk.version === '1');
  var u = sdk.user.get(); pass('userNickname', typeof u.nickname === 'string' && 'locale' in u, JSON.stringify(u));
  var r = sdk.role.get(); pass('roleName', typeof r.name === 'string', JSON.stringify(r));
  try { sdk.save.get('x'); pass('saveGetBeforeLoad', true, 'no throw: saves preloaded'); } catch (e) { pass('saveGetBeforeLoad', e && e.code === 'HOST_DENIED', e && e.code); }
  try { sdk.cache.set('k', 'v'); pass('cacheRoundTrip', sdk.cache.get('k') === 'v'); } catch (e) { pass('cacheRoundTrip', false, e && e.code); }
  pass('stageElWhenClosed', !!sdk.stage.el() && !sdk.stage.visible());
  pass('unknownEventSilent', (function () { try { sdk.on('message:finish', function () {}); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } })());
  var order = [];
  ['message:new', 'message:mount', 'message:done', 'ready', 'message:stream', 'message:unmount', 'theme:change', 'conversation:switch'].forEach(function (ev) {
    sdk.on(ev, function (p) {
      P.events.push([ev, p && p.id, p ? Object.keys(p).sort().join(',') : '']);
      if (ev === 'message:mount') {
        var inScope = document.querySelector('[data-chat="message"]');
        pass('scopedQueryInHandler', !!inScope && inScope.contains(document.querySelector('[data-chat="message-body"]')));
        var bubble = inScope;
        var domChecks = function () {
        var m = bubble && bubble.querySelector('.probe-marker');
        if (m) {
          pass('authorDataStripped', !m.hasAttribute('data-x'), m.outerHTML.slice(0, 80));
          var bar = document.querySelector('.probe-bar');
          pass('barAuthorDataStripped', bar ? !bar.hasAttribute('data-author') : null, bar ? bar.outerHTML.slice(0, 80) : 'no bar');
          var svg = bubble.querySelector('.probe-svg');
          pass('svgOnclickStripped', svg ? !svg.hasAttribute('onclick') : null);
          var btn = bubble.querySelector('.probe-btn');
          pass('buttonOnclickKept', btn ? btn.hasAttribute('onclick') : null);
          pass('cjkTagStripped', !bubble.querySelector('状态') && bubble.textContent.indexOf('cjk') >= 0);
          var f = bubble.querySelector('.probe-fields');
          pass('fieldTable', f && f.textContent === '1|2', f && f.textContent);
        }
        };
        domChecks(); setTimeout(domChecks, 1500); setTimeout(domChecks, 4000);
        setTimeout(function () { pass('barInlineScriptRan', window.__probeBarInline === 1 ? true : null, window.__probeBarInline === 1 ? 'ran (host-rendered bar)' : 'did not run (shell-rendered bar drops it); the play page decides'); }, 1500);
      }
      if (ev === 'ready') {
        var seq = P.events.map(function (e) { return e[0]; });
        pass('readyLast', seq[seq.length - 1] === 'ready');
        pass('coldStartOrder', seq.indexOf('message:new') < seq.indexOf('message:mount') && seq.indexOf('message:mount') < seq.indexOf('message:done'), seq.join('>'));
        var late = []; sdk.on('message:mount', function (p) { late.push(p.id); }); sdk.on('ready', function () { late.push('ready'); });
        setTimeout(function () { pass('mountReplayedNotReady', late.length > 0 && late.indexOf('ready') < 0, late.join(',')); }, 0);
        /* sequential: the key cap is checked before a write lands, so eleven concurrent sets all pass (noted in the handoff) */
        setTimeout(function () {
          var rejected = [], i = 0;
          var next = function () {
            if (i >= 11) { pass('saveElevenKeysRefused', rejected.indexOf('INVALID_ARGS') >= 0, 'rejected: ' + rejected.join(',')); return; }
            var k = 'k' + (i++);
            var p; try { p = sdk.save.set(k, i); } catch (e) { rejected.push(e && e.code); next(); return; }
            p.then(next, function (e) { rejected.push(e && e.code); next(); });
          };
          next();
        }, 50);
      }
    });
  });
  sdk.debug.log('probe installed');
})();
</script>
